name: Missouri Adams (Hall)
notable_stories: Though born as Matilda, she adopted the name Missouri as a child and used it for the remainder of her life
milestones: Migrated with the Adams family to Colorado in 1878
Buried at Fairmount Cemetery in Denver
notes: Siblings listed: John Wesley, Col. Alexander William, Mary, Joseph Pierre Jose, Harriet E., James Casper, Virginia M., Nancy E.
